tools.name: host_addCustomerNote
tools.description: Append a note to a customer's record, stamped with today's date and who wrote it. Nothing is overwritten. Use it to record what happened on a call.

note.description: What to record, e.g. 'Called about the double charge, promised a refund today.'

lifetimeValueCents.description: Integer cents. Excludes cancelled and fully refunded orders — money the shop actually kept.

tools.name: host_addShipmentEvent
tools.description: Record a carrier scan on a shipment. The shipment's own status follows the newest event, and a delivered scan closes out the order. A shipment that has already been delivered cannot be moved again.

id.description: Shipment id, tracking number, or the order it belongs to.

status.description: The new state: label_created, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, exception or returned.

location.description: Where the scan happened, e.g. 'Reno, NV'.

detail.description: Anything the carrier said, e.g. 'Address could not be verified'.

tools.name: host_adjustStock
tools.description: Correct how many units are on hand, and record why. Use a positive delta for a delivery received and a negative one for damage or a miscount. The adjustment cannot take stock below zero, and the reason is not optional — a stock level that changed with no reason attached is what nobody can audit later.

delta.description: Signed whole units. 12 means twelve arrived; -1 means one was damaged. Zero is rejected.

reason.description: Why the count changed, e.g. 'Purchase order PO-4417 received'.

sku.description: What a purchase order quotes, e.g. CRT-ESP-01.

stockReserved.description: Units spoken for by orders that have not shipped.

reorderPoint.description: Reorder when available stock falls to this.

available.description: stockOnHand minus stockReserved: what can actually be sold.

delta.description: Signed units: positive received, negative removed.

tools.name: host_cancelOrder
tools.description: Cancel an order that has not shipped yet. This releases its reserved stock and removes it from the customer's lifetime value. Only pending, paid or fulfilled orders can be cancelled — once something has shipped or been delivered, refund it instead.

reason.description: Why it was cancelled. Appended to the order's notes, e.g. 'customer changed their mind'.

number.description: The human-facing number a customer quotes, e.g. CR-1084.

status.description: pending: not paid. paid: money taken, nothing packed. fulfilled: picked and packed. shipped: with the carrier. delivered: it arrived. cancelled: stopped before it shipped. refunded: money returned in full.

totalCents.description: Integer cents: subtotal plus shipping plus tax.

actor.description: The staff member the write was recorded against.

tools.name: host_createRefund
tools.description: Send money back to the customer. THIS IRREVERSIBLY MOVES MONEY: there is no undo, and a refund cannot be taken back. Leave amount_cents out to refund everything still outstanding on the order. Refunding the full outstanding amount marks the order refunded and drops it out of the customer's lifetime value. An order that was never paid, or was cancelled, or has already been refunded in full, is refused. Only the shop owner may issue a refund; a support agent gets a 403 telling them to ask the owner.

order_id.description: Which order to refund. Order number (CR-1084) or id.

reason.description: Why: duplicate, defective, not_as_described, late_delivery, changed_mind or other.

amount_cents.description: How much to send back, in integer cents (48155 = $481.55). Must be positive and no more than the amount still outstanding. Omit to refund all of it.

note.description: Anything worth recording, e.g. 'Charged twice, 3 minutes apart. Delivered copy retained.'

amountCents.description: Integer cents sent back to the customer.

createdBy.description: The staff email or agent id that issued it.

remainingRefundableCents.description: Integer cents still refundable on this order after this refund. Zero means it is fully refunded.

tools.name: host_createShipment
tools.description: Hand a paid or fulfilled order to a carrier: creates the label, moves the order to shipped, and takes the units off the shelf. An order can only have one shipment, and only paid or fulfilled orders can ship.

carrier.description: UPS, USPS or FedEx. Defaults to UPS.

tools.name: host_fulfillOrder
tools.description: Mark a paid order as picked and packed. Nothing leaves the building yet — that is createShipment. Only paid orders can be fulfilled; calling it twice is harmless.

number.description: The human-facing number a customer quotes, e.g. CR-1084.

status.description: pending: not paid. paid: money taken, nothing packed. fulfilled: picked and packed. shipped: with the carrier. delivered: it arrived. cancelled: stopped before it shipped. refunded: money returned in full.

totalCents.description: Integer cents: subtotal plus shipping plus tax.

actor.description: The staff member the write was recorded against.

tools.name: host_resetDemo
tools.description: Throw away every change made since the server started and rebuild the seeded store, including the duplicate charge the demo hangs off. This DISCARDS ALL WORK — refunds, shipments, notes and stock corrections all disappear. Only for putting the demo back after someone has walked through it.

story.description: The duplicate-charge pair the demo hangs off. Read these rather than assuming any order number.
